translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Hayk'k'eedda uduns's'etuu sawiyaa zayitiyaa shittuwaa s'ink'k'etsanaw danddayiino; hewaadankka, guutsa eeyyatetsay aad'd'eeda eratetsaanne wolk'k'aama bonchchuwaa bayzzee.
Aad'd'eeda eranchcha asaa wozanay Aa ushechchaw kaaletsee; shin booza asaa wozanay haddirssaw kaaletsee.
Eeyya Asay ogiyaan hamettiyaa wodekka, aw akeeki baawa; hewaappe denddeeddawaan I booza gidiyaawaa Asay ubbay eree.
Ne kaappuu ne bollan hank'k'ettooppenne, ne suntsetteedda sa'aappe kichcha kichchoppa; ayaw gooppe, c'o"u giide danddayiyaawe wolk'k'aama bayzzuwaakka atto giissee.
Saluwaa gufantsan taani be'eedda hara iitabay de'ee; hewekka deriyaa mooddiyaawanttu ootsiyaa naak'uwaa.
Eeyyatuu daro d'ok'k'a suntsatetsaa oyk'k'iide de'iyaa wode, duretuu hirkki zik'k'a sa'aan utteeddino.
Taani, ayiletuu mooddiyaawanttudan paraa toggiide biishshiinanne k'ay mooddiyaawanttu ayiletuwaadan gediyaan hamettishin be'aad.
Ollaa bookkiyaa uray he ollaan I kunddana; k'ay gimbbiyaa dirssaa koliyaa uraa shooshshay dukkana.
Shuchchaa Aa sa'aappe aatsi yeggiyaa uray he shuchchaan deshettee; k'ay mitsaa k'oo'iyaa uraykka he mitsan deshettee.
Dulddumeedda kalttaa poshennan c'oo k'oo'ooppe, daro wolk'k'aa wurssee; shin aad'd'eeda eran ootsiyaawe oosuwaa darssee.
Shooshshay dukki diggina, shooshshaa jollissanaw ayanttiyaa ayanttuu he uraw aynne maaddenna.
Aad'd'eeda eranchchaa haasayay aw bonchchuwaa imissee; shin eeyyay bare doonaappe keseedda k'aalan I barew metuwaan gelee.
Eeyyay bare haasayaa booza k'aalan doommiide, iitatetsaaninne gooshshan polee.
Eeyyay darobaa haasayee. Gidooppenne, sintsappe hananaw de'iyaawaa ooninne erenna. Asi hayk'k'i kichchina, hananaw de'iyaawaa aw odanaw danddayiyaawe baawa.
Eeyya Asay bare oosuwaan daaburee; I bare golle biyaa ogiyaa erenna.
K'eeri na'aa gideedda kawuunne wontta guuraanna gibiraa giigissiide, barenttoo miyaa kaappatuu de'iyaa biittay new aayye ana!
Bonchchetteedda kawuunne matsuwaassa gidennaan wolk'k'aanne minotetsaa demmanaw maaran miyaanne ushiyaa kaappatuu de'iyaa biittata galatetteeddaano.
Bitanii azalla gidooppe, Aa kaaray woddee; Aa kushii oosuwaa billowaa gidooppe, Aa Gollii aatsee.
K'umaa miyaawaaninne woyniyaa eessaa ushiyaawan nashechchay beettee; shin miishshay ubbabaa shammee.

Sisiyaawe baawa gaade ne wozanaa k'ofaan gidooppenne, kaatiyaa boroppa; woy ne gisiyaa kifiliyaan duriyaa boroppa; ayaw gooppe, ne geeddawaa saluwaa kafuu woy, k'efiyaana med'etatuu biide, unttunttoo odana.
